name: Hormone therapy and cardiovascular disease, evidence available in 1994

assumptions.name: H_toward_lower_risk
assumptions.source: healthy-user bias among elective users of preventive hormones (Barrett-Connor 1991; Posthuma 1994)

assumptions.name: D_toward_higher_risk
assumptions.source: greater medical contact raises detected cancer incidence among users

assumptions.name: control_signed
assumptions.source: oestrogen increases or does not change cancer risk (Posthuma 1994; Grady 1992)

assumptions.name: H_shared
assumptions.source: same cohorts, same selection of users

assumptions.name: control_exact
assumptions.source: classical negative-control assumption (null control); deliberately strong
